summary: This bill amends the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 to establish a grant program that helps high-need local educational agencies hire and retain school social workers to meet recommended student-to-social worker ratios, and creates a national technical assistance center for school social work.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on education, specifically by providing grants to hire and retain school social workers in elementary and secondary schools. This directly increases spending on public schools to enhance student support services.
